diagnosis.what_happened: Table cells under the 'p' column redundantly contained the letter 'p' (e.g., '۰.۰۰۱ > p', 'p = ۰.۰۱۴', 'p < .۰۰۱') instead of reporting pure numbers or operators.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Repeating the variable/statistic symbol 'p' inside cells when the column header is already 'p' is redundant, clutters table layout, and violates APA 7 table design conventions.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Cells under 'p' column headers must contain strictly numeric values (e.g. '۰.۰۱۴', '۰.۰۳۵') or threshold operators with numbers (e.g. '< ۰.۰۰۱' or '۰.۰۰۱ >'), with zero occurrences of the letter 'p' or 'p ='.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Column headers define the metric for all rows beneath them. Including the metric symbol within each cell is typographical redundancy.

desired_behavior: Report strictly pure numbers or comparison operators in p-value cells; eliminate 'p =', 'p <', '> p' from all table data cells.
generalization: Never output the symbol 'p' or 'p =' inside table data cells when reporting statistical significance across any table in any academic project.

evidence.threshold_value: Zero occurrences of 'p' text inside table data cells
